main_body: Stone column: a vertical grey shaft (rows 16-40) with a wider cylindrical capital at the top (rows 8-15) and an identical one at the base (rows 40-47).
top_band: Light grey #adb1b7 at rows 9-11, with a brighter #c8ccd0 highlight at row 12 (the x=8 column). Rows 13-14 are a darker lip (L 150 at x=8, 124 at x=10), and row 15 is the outline.
evidence: The capital is wider than the shaft and has rounded corners, but it is shaded like the side of a horizontal cylinder. The same left-to-right gradient runs through the light rows and the lip rows, with one bright highlight line at row 12. That reads as a front-view band, not a top ellipse. Only about 3 rows (9-11) are clearly the top tone, under the 4 rows needed for a cap. Row 12 is an edge highlight and rows 13-14 are the lip, so neither counts as top face. This matches the guide's red 'flat band cap'. The base capital has the same construction. The shaft is a plain front-facing cylinder.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 8 distinct colours and a median of 8 per tile, against 38-40 colours and 17-20 per tile in the references. All of its dark edge pixels are neutral (100% near-neutral), which is the uniform sticker-style outline. The grey ramp is a clean gradient of about 6 steps. The shaft is vertical bands of one flat tone with no grain, speckle or chips, and the capitals have no texture. It is clearly thinner and flatter than the Beodeul references.
